verdict.rationale: Brave documents dedicated News, Image and Video search services, a Local/POI endpoint, and a Rich Search endpoint with real-time verticals including stocks, sports and weather. llms.txt and the official MCP server both confirm separate image, video and news search, so the verticals are reachable through specific endpoints. missing for 10: a dedicated finance endpoint (finance is only covered via stock data in Rich Search, sourced from third parties), detailed per-vertical parameter and filter documentation in the pack, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
